method: Read-only pinned Git blobs versus workspace SHA256, preexisting backend method ASTs, and pinned installed SDK source hashes. This audit runs no SDK, algorithm or native tests.

changed_file_digest_exclusions.docs/assets/motion_planning_v2/scope_aud: This audit cannot embed its own SHA256.
changed_file_digest_exclusions.docs/assets/motion_planning_v2/verificat: Verification embeds this audit SHA256; excluding its reverse digest avoids a circular dependency.

changed_files_method: git diff --name-only against the pinned V1 baseline plus the explicitly included V2 JSON assets, including this audit path without a recursive self-hash. The preexisting untracked models directory is excluded.

robot_skill_stack/integrations/isaac/boo.reason: Close only the selected strategy before V5 resources, including cancellation/construction cleanup; retain primary errors.

robot_skill_stack/integrations/isaac/con.reason: Select reactive and validate enabled/self-filtered mapping plus bounded obstacle budget; default direct remains.

robot_skill_stack/integrations/isaac/man.reason: Construct and inject the selected reactive strategy without duplicating robot/controller resources.
Expose optional intended-contact capability and selected-strategy cleanup; all preexisting method ASTs are checked.

robot_skill_stack/integrations/isaac/obs.reason: Enable optional prepared obstacle product only for reactive mapping; retain original direct construction path.

robot_skill_stack/manipulation/held_stat.reason: Propagate explicit source-unavailable and unsupported-motion results without disguising them as collision avoidance.

robot_skill_stack/manipulation/skills/pi.reason: Early explicit rejection of reactive intended-contact Pick before motion or gripper action.

robot_skill_stack/manipulation/skills/pl.reason: Early explicit rejection of reactive intended-contact Place before motion or release.

robot_skill_stack/world/spatial_mapping/.reason: Optional immutable obstacle product in the existing worker/publication; no occupancy math or quality changes.

limitations: Exact occupied-voxel boxes do not fill source FREE/UNKNOWN cells, but voxelization, partial observations, sparse-support rejection and the proxy budget still limit physical coverage.
The installed collision spheres approximate links/palm, with no separate dynamic finger or carried-object environment geometry.
Reactive intended-contact Pick/Place and carrying are explicitly unsupported; direct remains the validated manipulation baseline.
RMPflow is local reactive control. Blocked/time-out cases are not successful avoidance, and successful observed motion is not certified collision-free space.
preexisting_models: The untracked models directory is outside this audit and commit scope.
